P1_LCMS_three_published_m_z.what: our computed [M+H]+ for the TREN/glycidyl-ester ladder vs the three ESI m/z printed on SI p.5
P1_LCMS_three_published_m_z.split_ours_vs_their_formula: NOT AVAILABLE - the paper prints no molecular formula for H9T6 or any congener
P1_LCMS_three_published_m_z.verdict: 3/3 assigned at C10 and 0/3 at every other chain length the SI lists, so the tail of H9T6 is decanoate; the count moves from 3 to 0 under the seed.

P2_1H_NMR_integrals.what: integrals predicted from our H9T6 structure vs the integrals printed on SI p.5
P2_1H_NMR_integrals.not_checked: the 2.36-5.37 multiplet, printed as 46H; our structure predicts 48H there, and that window overlaps the separately-printed Halpha window, so the two integrals are not independent and the 2H gap is not evidence of anything either way
P2_1H_NMR_integrals.verdict: 4/4 exact on the independent windows; 1/4 under the seed.

P3_drawn_but_never_printed_reference_lin.what: both panels carry a dashed horizontal rule the authors drew at the SM102 benchmark and never labelled. Calibrate on the y ticks ONLY, then predict the rule's value; a round 1.0 is the target.
P3_drawn_but_never_printed_reference_lin.verdict: 0.35% and 0.02% off a round 1.0 on two independently calibrated panels; a 2% scale error would put them at 1.016 and 1.020, outside that.

P4_SM102_bar_is_unity_by_construction.what: every bar is divided by SM102, so SM102's own bar is exactly 1.000. It is measured by the same detector as a closed loop.
P4_SM102_bar_is_unity_by_construction.note: this is an END-TO-END check: axis, window, silhouette walk, stroke centre. It is NOT used to tune anything -- no constant in 04_digitize_figS4.py was fitted to it, which is the error class 27 trap.
P4_SM102_bar_is_unity_by_construction.verdict: both panels low by ~1.1-1.4%, a systematic sub-pixel bias; reported, not corrected.

P5_axis_leave_one_out.what: axis.loo_residuals on both tick ladders. calibrate's max-residual test is weak against a single bad tick; LOO is not.
P5_axis_leave_one_out.verdict: all four ladders <= 0.24 px; moving one tick by 6 px takes the worst LOO residual to the seeded value above, far past the 1.5 px tolerance.

P6_bar_top_crosscheck_vs_library.what: bars.bar_top run top-down over the same windows, with its own full-width, flank and baseline guards, against the bottom-up silhouette walk that produced the values.
P6_bar_top_crosscheck_vs_library.verdict: two detectors with different failure modes; where the library one returns at all it agrees within 1 px on most bars.

P7_formulation_mol_percent_sums.what: Table S1's four lipid mol% must sum to 100 on every row
P7_formulation_mol_percent_sums.verdict: all rows exact; the seed moves the count by one.

P8_cross_panel_same_formulations.what: Fig S3A and Fig S4C both report C2C12 luciferase relative to SM102 at 24 h for formulations 1-F1..1-F16, digitised independently (S3A by height ratio, no axis fit; S4C by a calibrated axis).
P8_cross_panel_same_formulations.verdict: the two panels RANK-agree at rho = 0.94 (p = 8e-06) and disagree in MAGNITUDE by a median factor of ~9. Two independent reads of two different panels tracking each other that closely is strong evidence the reads are right; the factor of 9 is the paper's, not ours, and means 'relative to SM102' does not denote the same quantity in the two figures. See 08_contradictions.csv C-04.
